reference_cohort_info_part.pre_trained_note: This study uses a pre-trained normative reference model (n=58,836) from Rutherford et al. 2022 (Elife, 11:e72904) via the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits. The model was adapted/calibrated to the local University of Alabama at Birmingham site using 92 healthy controls. As a Pre-trained model study, RCI-1 through RCI-7 extraction is not applicable.

rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We quantified individual deviations for each region (and averaged those for bilateral regions) based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits (Figure 1)." "We used control data to calibrate normative curves."
